dossier.researchSummary: Checkpoint-scoped dossier assembled from the official Hugging Face model pages and repository blobs listed in sources. The Wan2.2-TI2V-5B-Diffusers model page and its README/model_index.json assert a TI2V (text-image-video) diffusion model family with a dense 5B variant and an MoE A14B variant described; model_index.json lists pipeline and component classes (WanPipeline, T5TokenizerFast, UMT5EncoderModel, WanTransformer3DModel, AutoencoderKLWan, UniPCMultistepScheduler). config.json (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B repo) provides numeric hyperparameters (dim: 3072; ffn_dim: 14336; num_heads: 24; num_layers: 30; text_len: 512). README blobs assert capability for text-to-video and image-to-video, claim 720P (1280x704 or 704x1280) at 24 FPS and include example generation flags for a 5-second example; README also describes MoE expert parameter counts (~14B per expert, ~27B total for A14B series). The primary blobs do not contain numeric benchmark tables, standardized latency benchmarking methodology, or explicit safety/privacy/dataset-provenance statements for this exact checkpoint; those are recorded as evidence gaps.
